_note: Team news for every fixture within 72 hours, discovered directly from the canonical fixture feed so a newly generated Best Pick is already covered. The automatic collector searches two free RSS indexes, retains article URL/publisher/time as evidence, and changes out/doubt only after two independent publishers corroborate an explicit player-status claim. One-source and vague reports are recorded but cannot alter the model. Manual official/confirmed entries and confirmed lineups are preserved. 'checked' is written only when both searches succeeded; sanity_check fails an imminent publish when news is missing or stale. Run: python -m scripts.sync_team_news.

Arsenal.note: Saliba (back) and Timber (groin) ruled out. Saka and Rice both passed fit and are expected to start. Guimarães has a minor knock from the City game -- Arteta called him 'evolving well' and said a late fitness call would decide it; one outlet still expects him to start, so listed as doubt on the conservative reading.

Coventry.note: Wright (thigh/quad) out into late 2026. Woolfenden (knee) confirmed out, expected back next month. Lampard directly confirmed Onyeka (hip) fit and available ('he's available') and Rudoni is in the predicted XI -- both cleared from doubt. Cherif remains a fitness doubt as he builds match sharpness. Bobby Thomas (cramp vs Hull) expected to continue at centre-back.

Manchester City.note: Doku out with a calf injury from the Community Shield. Haaland fit and expected to start (posted training footage pre-match, no fitness concern reported); Matheus Nunes available per Maresca. Enzo Fernandez and Iliman Ndiaye both in line for their City debuts after summer arrivals.

Ath Madrid.note: Sorloth (muscle contracture, official club statement 12-13 Aug) ruled out of the season opener -- directly affects tonight's anytime-goalscorer pick on him. Baena (low-grade muscle injury, confirmed ~2 weeks out from ~13 Aug) also out. Alvarez only returned to training this week post-World-Cup break, unlikely fit. Romero still building match fitness after a World Cup final injury. Barrios subbed at halftime of Friday's Marseille friendly with muscular discomfort, doubtful.

Malaga.note: Re-checked ahead of the Real Madrid trip (30 Aug, two independent sources: Goal.com team-news page + Yardbarker 'numerous absences' report, both dated 30 Aug): Ochoa's absence is now reported as a torn meniscus requiring surgery, not the earlier suspension -- longer-term, still out either way. Dotor, Calero, Murillo, Nino confirmed still out. Moussa Diarra newly reported unavailable (not previously listed). Juanpe still working back from a hamstring injury, could miss out.

Sociedad.note: Odriozola (long-term knee injury) out, leaving Jon Aramburu as the only fit senior right-back option for the trip to the Bernabeu. Marín, Gorrotxategi and Guedes all carry muscle tightness needing a late fitness check (Sports Mole, Heavy.com, 26 Aug). Oyarzabal is fully fit and expected to start up front alongside Kubo and Barrenetxea.

Real Madrid.note: Predicted XI vs Sociedad (Sportsmole/SI, 26 Aug): Courtois; Dumfries, Konate, Rudiger, Cucurella; Valverde, Guler; Diomande, Bellingham, Vinicius; Mbappe -- both Mbappe and Vinicius set to start. Militao (muscle), Rodrygo (knee), Asencio (thigh) and Mendy (hip) confirmed out. Tchouameni (thigh) confirmed by Mourinho as not recovered in time. Endrick and Thiago Pitarch doubtful (muscle/knee). Bellingham had an ankle knock but appears in the predicted starting XI and is expected to play. Independently re-confirmed 17:20Z via a second search (Managing Madrid/Heavy.com): same absentee list, with Tchouameni/Endrick also reported as having failed late fitness checks -- kept under doubt since no single source confirms both as officially scratched from the squad list. Re-checked ahead of kickoff (30 Aug, Goal.com team-news + Managing Madrid preview, both dated 30 Aug): same absentee picture, none of the injured expected back for Malaga; Mbappe and Vinicius (both on the props board) confirmed fit and expected to start, no new fitness concerns for either.

Dortmund.note: Schlotterbeck (ankle, World Cup injury) ruled out of the season opener; Emre Can still injured. Bensebaini was sent off in the Supercup and is carrying a rib problem -- one predicted XI still starts him, another calls him a doubt, so listed conservatively as doubt. Guirassy (board player, goal + shots picks) is confirmed in every predicted XI leading the line -- no fitness concern for him (Sports Mole/Yahoo/Fear The Wall, 29 Aug).

Hamburg.note: No major injury concerns -- Polzin expected to have a full squad available (Sports Mole, Yahoo, 29 Aug). Squad departures earlier in the window (Glatzel, Balde, Mikelbrencis) are transfers, not injuries, and are already reflected in the roster.

Bologna.note: Orsolini out ~3 weeks with a left thigh flexor injury suffered vs Atalanta (Yahoo Sports, LaPresse), will miss Sassuolo/Napoli/Torino
